scripts.predev: node -e "const major = +process.versions.node.split('.')[0]; if (major < 20) { console.error('Node >= 20 required (found ' + process.version + ') — run: nvm use'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n frontend,backend,ml -c cyan,green,magenta "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev:ml"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend && npm run install:ml
scripts.install:ml: cd ml-service && (command -v python3.12 >/dev/null 2>&1 && python3.12 -m venv .venv || python3 -m venv .venv) && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
